mapper.select: SELECT r.record_id, r.file_id, r.seal_id, r.user_id, r.project_id, r.sign_mode, r.positions, r.has_timestamp, r.span_config, r.client_ip, r.ip_location, r.os_version, r.browser_version, r.status, r.signed_file_id, r.cert_id, r.serial_no, r.fingerprint_sha256, r.verify_status, r.sign_hash, r.page_fingerprint, r.sign_time, r.create_time, p.project_name, s.seal_name, u.nickname AS nick_name, u.username AS user_name, sf.file_name, ss.file_name AS signed_file_name FROM sign_record r LEFT JOIN sign_project p ON r.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN sign_seal s ON r.seal_id = s.seal_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sign_file sf ON r.file_id = sf.file_id LEFT JOIN sign_file ss ON r.signed_file_id = ss.file_id WHERE r.record_id = #{recordId}
SELECT * FROM sign_record WHERE signed_file_id = #{signedFileId} ORDER BY sign_time DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sign_record ( record_id, file_id, seal_id, user_id, project_id, sign_mode, positions, has_timestamp, span_config, client_ip, ip_location, os_version, browser_version, status, signed_file_id, cert_id, serial_no, fingerprint_sha256, verify_status, sign_hash, page_fingerprint, sign_time, create_time, tenant_id, create_user, dept_id ) VALUES ( #{recordId}, #{fileId}, #{sealId}, #{userId}, #{projectId}, #{signMode}, #{positions}, #{hasTimestamp}, #{spanConfig}, #{clientIp}, #{ipLocation}, #{osVersion}, #{browserVersion}, #{status}, #{signedFileId}, #{certId}, #{serialNo}, #{fingerprintSha256}, #{verifyStatus}, #{signHash}, #{pageFingerprint}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{createTime}, #{tenantId}, #{createUser}, #{deptId} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.record_id, r.seal_id, r.user_id, r.project_id, r.cert_id, r.serial_no, r.fingerprint_sha256, r.verify_status, r.sign_hash, r.page_fingerprint, r.sign_time, r.create_time, p.project_name, s.seal_name, u.nickname AS nick_name FROM sign_record r LEFT JOIN sign_project p ON r.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN sign_seal s ON r.seal_id = s.seal_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id ORDER BY r.sign_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sign_record WHERE sign_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
